inputs.name: registerReportCommand.program
inputs.description: The commander Command that the 'report' subcommand is added to; it matters on every call because registerReportCommand uses it only to call program.command('report'). The function does not validate it or keep a reference to it after that call.

outputs.name: registerReportCommand
outputs.description: The function returns nothing (void); its only effect is to add a 'report' subcommand to the given program, with the description 'Record media reports and serve the website.', unknown options and excess arguments allowed, an optional variadic '[args...]' argument, and an action. That action calls runReport with the args array only when the command runs, so calling this function never invokes runReport.
